notes.title: Common Controller Issues and Troubleshooting
notes.notes:
Are you having issues with your controllers? We're compiling issues and giving potential workarounds for people who have been having with the scrambled controllers, how to play with the keyboard. etc. if you are still having issues please list the controller you are using (Brand, Model), how the controller is connected (via USB wire, wireless via dongle, wireless via bluetooth) in this thread along with any other pertinent details. Alternatively, please visit this thread and again leave any pertinent details: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1184560/discussions/0/4543572243355121342/]https://steamcommunity.com/app/1184560/discussions/0/4543572243355121342/[/url]

Q: I want to control the game with my keyboard.
A: Make sure there are no USB / wireless controllers connected to the game before you start the game and you should be able to control the game with the keyboard. Use WASD for directional control and B = Confirm J = Cancel

Q: I’m using a (insert controller name here) controller and my buttons are scrambled.
A: First try disabling "Steam input" in the general Steam settings. Second, try disabling Controller Configuration Support for your Xbox/PS controller through Steam > Controller > General Controller Settings.

Q: I’m using a Xbox One controller connected via Bluetooth and my buttons are scrambled.
A: Connect your controller via USB directly to your PC.

Q: My controller is being detected as 2P instead of 1P
A: First try going into the Steam Settings > Controller > General Controller Settings > Check “XBOX Configuration Support” and see if Steam recognizes your controller and makes that the primary.

Alternatively, delete instances of "Xbox One" controller under Control Panel > Hardware and Sound > Devices and Printers and unplug / replug and/or disconnect/reconnect your controller. Make sure that steam or the game are closed before you do this.

Another thing to try is to delete any instances of "Xbox Controller or similar" in your Device Manager under Sound, Video and Game controllers. and unplug / replug and/or disconnect/reconnect your controller. Make sure that steam or the game are closed before you do this.

Q: I am running windows 7 and the Phantom Breaker: Omnia will not start.
A: Phantom Breaker: Omnia requires Windows 10 to operate. Windows 7 is not officially supported.

Q: I have 2 controllers plugged in, but when I start a 1P vs 2P game the 2P player does not work.
A: Be sure to press the "Start" button equivalent on the 2P controller to activate the second player.

notes.title: Phantom Breaker: Omnia's New Characters Revealed!
notes.notes:
The long awaited reveal of Phantom Breaker: Omnia's two new characters is finally here! World meet, Artifactor and Maestra!

Artifactor: A capricious cosmic architect from a god-like race of beings known as Reverants. One of the original creators of the universe, the so-called ‘Fu-menison Artifacts’ – mystical weapons of great strength – were tools of her design used to construct reality as we know it. She is currently the only known Reverant left in existence.

Artifactor is voiced by Yui Nakajima (Japanese) and [url=https://twitter.com/SoCassandra]Cassandra Lee Morris[/url] (English).

Maestra: She once dwelled in Mikoto's Fu-mension Artifact, Maestro, until Mikoto's wish to not fight made her manifest into being. Though naive and a bit clumsy outside of battle, she bravely fights in Mikoto's stead and loves her mistress dearly. Ever protective, she stays close to Mikoto's side at all times.

Maestra is voiced by Mai Sato (Japanese) and [url=https://twitter.com/ItsXanthor]Xanthe Huynh[/url] (English).

notes.title: Phantom Breaker: Omnia Launches March 15, 2022
notes.notes:
El Segundo, Calif. – December 13, 2021 –  Publisher Rocket Panda Games and developer MAGES are excited to to reveal that Phantom Breaker: Omnia, the latest installment in the beloved 2D anime fighting saga, is coming to PlayStation 4, Xbox One, Nintendo Switch and Steam (PC) on March 15, 2022 for a MSRP of $39.99. The team has presented a new trailer to go along with this announcement, please watch below.

[previewyoutube=qJzbTVGDtNQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Phantom Breaker Omnia is a massive update to Phantom Breaker: Extra, a 2D anime fighting game released only in Japan in 2011. For the first time in the series’ history, this chapter will be available to Western audiences including new characters, full HD graphics, and much more!

“Today, the team is ecstatic to announce ‘Phantom Breaker: Omnia’s’ release date,” said M. Panda, Executive Panda and Co-Founder of Rocket Panda Games. “The addition of new characters, features and updates to the game has taken more time than anticipated – but for our first self-published game we had to ensure we’re producing the game to the best of our ability. The ‘Phantom Breaker: Omnia’ project has evolved far beyond a simple port and has become an enhanced and complete Phantom Breaker experience. The fire in all of our hearts will be burning next March!”

Phantom Breaker: Omnia will be the first fighting game title in the franchise to see a Western release after the successful 2013 launch of the 2D side-scrolling beat ’em up spin-off Phantom Breaker: Battle Grounds which sold over 400,000 copies.

In the game, a mysterious man, known only as ‘Phantom’ appears in Tokyo, to manipulate vulnerable adolescents into fighting each other, bestowing upon them mystical weapons of great strength known as ‘Fu-mension Artifacts.’ In exchange, he promised to grant their wish if they survive. The fierce clashes between these artifacts caused distortions in space-time, which compromised the boundaries between parallel universes. The collapse of these parallel universes would ultimately break the seal, unleashing Phantom’s destructive powers.

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]20 Characters[/b] – Includes all characters from Phantom Breaker: Extra like Kurisu , Makise from Steins;Gate and two brand new characters created specifically for Phantom Breaker: Omnia.[/list][list]
[*] [b]Three different fighting styles: Quick, Hard, and Omnia[/b] – Drastically change your characters’ speed, power, and mechanics based on your choice.[/list][list]
[*] [b]Complex combos returned and rebalanced[/b] – Pulling off amazing combos and special attacks has never been easier as Phantom Breaker: Omnia’s fighting system has been overhauled and rebalanced.[/list][list]
[*] [b]Dual language audio and more[/b] – A first on the Phantom Breaker series, all characters will have English voice acting. The game’s text will be also translated into English, Japanese, French, Italian, German, Spanish, Simplified and Traditional Chinese.[/list][list]
[*] [b]Modern, remixed soundtrack[/b] – The background music for each character has been redone and remixed with the option to play the original background music.[/list][list]
[*] [b]The complete experience[/b] – Players can immerse themselves with the stories from both the original Phantom Breaker and Phantom Breaker: Extra.[/list]

notes.title: Important Announcement Regarding the Release Timing of Phantom Breaker: Omnia
notes.notes:
It was always our hope to release Phantom Breaker: Omnia before the end of the year, but even the best-laid plans go astray. While we are very far along in development, we are taking extra care to ensure that the console versions are at a level that we are satisfied with. So instead of compromising the quality of the game or putting unreasonable pressure on our development team we’ve decided to move the release date of the game to early 2022. We at Rocket Panda Games humbly apologize for the delay and thank you for your patience and continued support.
– Gail Salamanca | Co-Founder, Rocket Panda Games

The producer for Phantom Breaker: Omnia, Sakari-san has shared a quick statement regarding the delay which we’ve translated below.

皆さんこんにちは。『ファントムブレイカー：オムニア』開発プロデューサー兼ディレクター、サカリPです。今回は残念なご報告をさせていただきます。

2021年内発売を目指して開発を進めてきた『ファントムブレイカー：オムニア』ですが、発売を2022年に延期させていただくことになりました。期待してお待ちいただいていた皆さまには本当に申し訳なく思います。

想定していたよりも移植作業及び多言語化に手間取ってしまったことが原因です。

そして、これは全て自分の責任です。現在の開発状況としては、Xbox ONE、PS4、Nintendo Switch, PC の全てで ゲームが動作しており、デバッグ作業を開始しようとしている状態です。

正式な発売日は後日改めて発表させていただきますが、来年の比較的早い時期には皆さまのお手元にお届けできる予定です。不安に感じる方もいらっしゃるでしょうが、間違いなく、絶対に発売しますので、もう少しだけお時間をいただきたく思います。

よろしくお願いいたします。

notes.title: Phantom Breaker Omnia "Player's Choice: Round Start!" Campaign
notes.notes:
Hey All,

I'm new to this, so please excuse any wonkiness!

Just wanted to let you all know that we launched the "Player's Choice: Round Start!" campaign. It's a series of polls for where we allow fans to vote for their favorite "Round Start" line from a set of 4 pre-determined lines on our [url=https://twitter.com/RocketPandaEN]official Twitter account[/url]. Every character in the game (20) will have their own poll which will last for approximately 3-4 days each. The line with the most votes from each poll will be implemented as one of the characters' voiced "round start" lines in the actual game. The entire campaign will last until the beginning of December.

The first poll, features Mikoto [voiced by Erica Mendez (Retsuko in Aggretsuko, Ryuko Matoi in KILL la KILL)], who is the main protagonist of Phantom Breaker: Omnia. The first poll can be found here: [url=https://bit.ly/3eee1WI]https://bit.ly/3eee1WI[/url]
